pages.name: profile-marketing
pages.after: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(x=>x.textContent==='Marketing choices');if(h){h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const s=h.closest('section');return {panel:true,checked:[...s.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')].map(c=>c.checked),saveDisabled:s.querySelector('button[type=submit]')?.disabled,text:s.innerText.slice(0,300)}}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250))}return {panel:false}})()
